SELECT EMP_NO, EMP_NAME FROM EMPLOYEE
(LOWER(EMP_NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{query}) || '%' OR LOWER(EMP_NO) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{query}) || '%')
ORDER BY EMP_NO ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WAREHOUSE w JOIN EMPLOYEE e ON w.EMP_NO = e.EMP_NO
AND (w.WH_CODE LIKE '%' || #{dto.keyword} || '%' OR w.WH_NAME LIKE '%' || #{dto.keyword} || '%')

SELECT w.WH_ID, w.WH_CODE, w.WH_NAME, w.ADDRESS, w.ADDRESS_DETAIL, w.REMARK, w.EMP_NO, w.POST_CODE, w.CREATED_AT, w.UPDATED_AT, e.EMP_NAME, e.TEL as empTel, COALESCE(inv_summary.total_items, 0) as totalItems, COALESCE(inv_summary.current_stock, 0) as currentStock, COALESCE(inv_summary.expected_stock, 0) as expectedStock, COALESCE(inv_summary.allocated_stock, 0) as allocatedStock, COALESCE(inv_summary.available_stock, 0) as availableStock FROM WAREHOUSE w JOIN EMPLOYEE e ON w.EMP_NO = e.EMP_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT WH_ID, COUNT(*) as total_items, SUM(CURRENT_QTY) as current_stock, SUM(EXPECTED_QTY) as expected_stock, SUM(ALLOCATED_QTY) as allocated_stock, SUM(CURRENT_QTY + EXPECTED_QTY - ALLOCATED_QTY) as available_stock FROM INVENTORY GROUP BY WH_ID ) inv_summary ON w.WH_ID = inv_summary.WH_ID WHERE w.WH_ID = #{whId}
mapper.update: UPDATE WAREHOUSE SET WH_CODE = #{whCode}, WH_NAME = #{whName}, REMARK = #{remark}, EMP_NO = #{empNo}, ADDRESS = #{address}, ADDRESS_DETAIL = #{addressDetail}, POST_CODE = #{postCode} WHERE WH_ID = #{whId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WAREHOUSE ( WH_CODE, WH_NAME, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_DETAIL, REMARK, POST_CODE, EMP_NO ) VALUES ( #{whCode}, #{whName}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, #{remark}, #{postCode}, #{empNo} )
